description: Boolean status indicator stored as string with inconsistent representations ('True'/'False', '1'/'0', 'yes'/'no'). Contains 30 non-null records with 6 distinct categorical values encoding binary states.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Convert string representations to boolean type: 'True', '1', 'yes' → True and 'False', '0', 'no' → False.
[VALIDATE] Ensure all values conform to the standardized boolean format (True/False) after conversion.
